title: Binding Constraints in a Strategic Technology: An Industrial Vulnerability Index for the Foundation Model Industry
abstract: arXiv:2510.23421v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Industrial policy directed at artificial intelligence has become substantial. Public investment concentrates on compute, where private capacity expansion is already underway, and is largely absent from grid interconnection and generation. Whether that allocation accurately reflects the most binding constraint in production has not yet been systematically measured. This paper introduces the Artificial Intelligence Industrial Vulnerability Index (AIIVI) as a framework for assessing potential production constraints in frontier AI. We construct a composite index of input vulnerability for the foundation model industry from fourteen concentration and sustainability parameters, aggregated by an O-Ring functional form in which capability is strongly influenced by the most constrained input. translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.23421v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：针对人工智能的产业政策已变得相当可观。公共投资集中于算力领域——而私人产能扩张已在进行中——并且在电网互联与发电方面几乎缺位。这种资源配置是否准确反映了生产中最具约束性的瓶颈，尚未得到系统性测量。本文提出了人工智能工业脆弱性指数（AIIVI），作为评估前沿人工智能潜在生产约束的框架。我们从十四个集中度与可持续性参数构建了基础模型产业的投入脆弱性综合指数，并通过 O-Ring 函数形式进行聚合——在该形式中，模型能力受最受限投入的强烈影响。AIIVI 不应被解释为对生产约束的直接测量，而是提供了一个基于指数的近似……
tldr: 本文提出人工智能工业脆弱性指数（AIIVI），利用十四个集中度与可持续性参数并通过 O-Ring 函数形式聚合，用以评估基础模型产业中最具约束性的生产瓶颈，揭示了当前产业政策聚焦算力而忽视电网等环节的配置可能偏离真正的约束所在。
